response.text: The NULL values appear to be strings. I'll check that and look at the remaining items: manual accrual patterns, the reversal, payments, and the journal 1597 invoice.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'ref_is_string_NULL' k, count(*) c FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO"::text='NULL'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_sql_null', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_pairs_ok', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" AND h."SRC_CD"='AP' WHERE h."POST_DT"=p."PAY_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_journals', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_REF" LIKE 'PAY-%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_before_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_date_ne_jrnl_date', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_srcref_ne_vendinvno', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."SRC_REF"<>i."INV_NO"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_in_closed_prd_jrnl_dt_gt_close', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT">p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_amt_ne_ap_cr', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD"='2000    ' WHERE l."CR_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_cd_len', count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE length("VEND_CD")<>8
UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_mixed_user_case', count(DISTINCT "SRC_REF") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL'
UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_no_min', min("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH"
UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_no_max', max("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH"

SELECT "JRNL_NO","PRD_ID","POST_DT","SRC_REF","MEMO",(SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT",' ' ORDER BY "LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE "JRNL_NO" IN (2436,2470,1597) OR "MEMO" NOT IN ('Manual accrual') AND "SRC_CD"='GL' ORDER BY 1
SELECT "SRC_REF", count(*), min("POST_DT"), max("POST_DT"), sum(CASE WHEN "PRD_ID">=11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
